metaDescription: Order custom sublimation keychains in bulk from Perfect Imprints. Full-color, durable designs for your brand.
introHtml: Sublimation keychains let you print full-color logos, photos, or gradients that won't peel or fade. Unlike traditional pad printing or engraving, sublimation bonds the ink into the material, giving you vibrant, edge-to-edge coverage on neoprene fobs and other compatible surfaces. These keychains are ideal for trade show giveaways, employee recognition, or retail promotions where visual impact matters. The Sublimated Neoprene Fob With Keyring is a popular choice for its soft feel and durable print.
heroAltText: Custom sublimation keychains with full-color printed neoprene fobs and keyrings
